dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular and jagged 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible along the dorsal ridge, exhibiting a sharp, high-contrast transition from charcoal-colored perimeters to light silver-grey interior regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, asymmetrical, solid light-colored blobs observed on the mid-lateral flank, characterized by a lack of internal gradient and tight proximity to one another.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal region form an obtuse triangle with its longest side oriented parallel to the animal's longitudinal axis.
